# Keep video rendering consistent with the selected OH backend

## Platform difference

A media backend can need a particular texture/native-window integration; apparently equivalent Flutter wrappers can change whether frames appear.

## Implementation

PiliPlus bypasses a nested Transform/FittedBox path on OH after a reported matrix-related black screen. Simple Live reverts a direct Texture experiment and restores VideoPlayer. NipaPlay selects Erika/FVP-MDK paths, supplies a TextureRegistry-to-OHNativeWindow bridge, and leaves another renderer unavailable until its own native bridge exists. Its decoder list explicitly adds OH while retaining software candidates.

## Applicability

Apply rendering workarounds only to the relevant backend/embedding versions. The projects choose different working sets; NipaPlay skipping MediaKit does not invalidate PiliPlus' different integration.

These observations apply to the pinned project revisions below, studied on 2026-09-30 and backfilled on 2026-10-06. Unspecified SDK/device compatibility remains unknown; this is not a fresh upstream assessment.

## Pitfalls and limitations

Player initialization or a selected hardware decoder label is not proof of a rendered or hardware-decoded frame. Bypassing the plugin widget can omit required lifecycle or surface behavior.

## Verification

Test actual first frames, resize/orientation, disposal/recreation, backend switching and codec fallback; collect native decoder evidence before making hardware-acceleration claims.

Evidence tier: historical source/diff studies, with commit and path existence rechecked in local Git during this backfill. No application build, dependency resolution, signing, installation or device execution was performed. Proposed checks above are acceptance criteria, not completed tests.
